name: Markdown Table Generator
summary: Build GitHub-flavored Markdown tables from an editable grid — locally in your browser.
description: Set columns and rows, edit headers and cells, choose left/center/right alignment per column, and copy pretty or compact Markdown. Pipe characters in cells are escaped. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Does it support column alignment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each column can be left, center, or right using standard GFM alignment markers.

faqs.question: What if a cell contains a pipe?
faqs.answer: Pipes are escaped as \| so the table stays valid.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
